run_pybullet_gui_server: run a pybullet GUI server that connects and keeps the simulation loop alive
connect_gui_server: connect to a pybullet GUI server using p.connect with the GUI_SERVER mode
set_search_path: set the additional search path for pybullet data assets using pybullet_data.getDataPath
review_run_server_script: review the pybullet runServer script that starts a GUI server and enters an infinite loop
summarize_run_server: summarize the pybullet runServer script which connects to GUI and polls physics engine parameters
